summary: Strengthen SRHR counselling, contraceptive decisions and referral pathways through practical case work. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) practice links accessible services with informed, voluntary care. For midwives, nurses and programme coordinators, the course develops practical ways to support consistent service pathways. Participants practise contraceptive eligibility decisions and balanced counselling, and build referral and follow-up workflows that support consent, confidentiality and continuity across maternal, STI and HIV services.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who make or supervise sexual and reproductive health service decisions. It suits people with prior exposure to health services, referral work or SRHR programming.
modules: ICPD SRHR Rights and Service Pathways
WHO STI and HIV Referral Linkages
SRHR Quality Review and Improvement Plan
prerequisites: Prior exposure to health service delivery, community health work or SRHR programming is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
